name: core--litellm-fable-5-model
description: Claude Fable 5 (and its first-party-only sibling Mythos 5) are served by the LiteLLM proxy so Claude Code clients can select them through headroom

implementation.change: Add claude-fable-5 and claude-mythos-5 entries to model_list, routed directly to anthropic/ (BYOK: client bearer token forwarded as x-api-key, no server-side Anthropic key)

checks: Model IDs verified in two independent Anthropic-shipped binaries: /Applications/Claude.app app.asar model catalog and the bundled CLI in the newest ~/.vscode/extensions/anthropic.claude-code-*
Catalog entry confirms id=claude-fable-5, family=fable, provider_ids.first_party=claude-fable-5, alias fable -> claude-fable-5, best=fable
litellm-config.yaml.j2 contains model_name claude-fable-5 with litellm_params.model anthropic/claude-fable-5
litellm-config.yaml.j2 contains model_name claude-mythos-5 with litellm_params.model anthropic/claude-mythos-5
Rendered /opt/koeff-ai-stack/litellm-config.yaml on 192.168.31.152 contains both entries and no unrendered {{ }} placeholder
LiteLLM container restarted and GET http://localhost:4000/models lists claude-fable-5 and claude-mythos-5
Previously served models (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) still listed after restart

Routing probe: POST /v1/chat/completions with a deliberately invalid x-api-key returns Anthropic authentication_error (not a LiteLLM 'model not found'), for both claude-fable-5 and claude-mythos-5 — proves BYOK header forwarding reaches Anthropic

No other eval in this repo targets litellm-config.yaml.j2, so no cross-eval regression re-validation was required (005/009/011 target docker-compose.yml.j2, 010 targets nginx-ingest.conf.j2 — both untouched)
